title: Short term health insurance
summary: Overview of UnitedHealthcare short term limited duration health plans underwritten by Golden Rule Insurance Company, including who they suit, what they cover and how they differ from ACA plans.

assets.alt: Short term health insurance hero image

atoms.title: What are short term limited duration plans?
atoms.question: What is short term health insurance?
atoms.text: Short term limited duration health plans help bridge gaps in coverage. With options lasting from 1 month to nearly 3 years, short term plans underwritten by Golden Rule Insurance Company can provide a temporary solution to get the benefits you want for the time you need. Short term insurance is also called temporary health insurance or term health insurance.
questions: Who underwrites UnitedHealthcare short term plans?

atoms.title: Short Term Medical versus TriTerm Medical
atoms.question: What is the difference between Short Term Medical and TriTerm Medical?
atoms.text: UnitedHealthcare offers two kinds of short term plans. Short Term Medical plans last 1 month up to nearly 12 months. TriTerm Medical plans last nearly 3 years. The page describes these short term plans as underwritten by Golden Rule Insurance Company.

What are the two types of short term plans?

atoms.title: Situations where short term insurance may fit
atoms.question: When is short term insurance the right choice?
atoms.text: Short term insurance may be right if you're waiting for open enrollment to apply for an ACA plan; don't have a qualifying life event or Special Enrollment Period to apply for an ACA plan; are waiting for ACA coverage to start; need coverage to bridge you to Medicare; are turning 26 and coming off a parent's insurance; are between jobs or waiting for benefits at a new job; or are healthy and under 65.
questions: Can I use short term insurance until Medicare starts?
What if I missed open enrollment?

atoms.title: Short term plan coverage details
atoms.question: What do short term plans cover?
atoms.text: Preexisting conditions are not covered with most short term plans, so check your state's definition of preexisting conditions; Short Term Medical plans are medically underwritten. Limited preventive care can sometimes be covered. Prescription coverage may be available with some plans. Coverage for some telehealth (virtual visits) services may be included.
questions: Do short term plans cover prescriptions?
Is telehealth covered under short term insurance?

atoms.title: ACA plans versus short term plans
atoms.question: How are short term insurance plans different from ACA plans?
atoms.text: ACA plans cover preexisting conditions and you cannot be denied coverage based on them. Short term plans do not: you must answer a series of medical questions to apply, and Short Term Medical plans are medically underwritten. ACA plans are required to cover 10 essential health benefits, including maternity and newborn care and mental health and substance abuse disorder services. Short term plans have no specific coverage requirements and vary in what they cover.

Do short term plans cover essential health benefits?

atoms.title: Short term insurance can save money but needs review
atoms.question: Is short term insurance a good way to save money?
atoms.text: You may save money by choosing short term health insurance, but you should know what you are buying and make sure it's a good choice for you. For the right situation, short term insurance plans can provide fast, flexible, temporary health insurance coverage that fits your needs.

atoms.title: Golden Rule short term experience: over 35 years
atoms.question: How long has Golden Rule offered short term insurance?
atoms.text: Golden Rule Insurance Company, which underwrites UnitedHealthcare branded short term medical insurance, has been offering short term insurance plans for over 35 years, according to the short term insurance page.

atoms.title: Help and quotes for short term plans
atoms.question: How can I get a quote or help with a short term plan?
atoms.text: Shoppers can enter a ZIP code to see short term plans available in their area. For questions, UnitedHealthcare lists 1-866-487-9299, and a separate FAQ page covers more details about how short term plans work.
